scores.evidence: The objectives did not change, and q2, q3 (o1) and q6 (o2) keep their objectiveId and Bloom level after the option edits. Every objective still has 2 or more items, including apply-level or higher ones, and e1 and e3 remain transfer items. As before, o1 is a create objective, but only pr-checklist checks it at that level.

hook-b1 sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences (「毎回同じ手順をClaude Codeに貼り付けていませんか」), and the ungraded hook-q leads into 7-1. But hook-q mostly asks learners to recall lesson 6 (its explanation says 「（第6回）」), and the second problem in hook-b1, research output flooding the conversation, gets no prediction.

The glossary entries now end in です (「Claudeが一度に扱える情報の枠です。」), and the terms and aliases have not changed. They still match s1-defs and s3-defs (「コンテキストウィンドウ（context window）」). summary-next now names the exact next lesson, 「第8回｜フックで守らせ、MCPでつなぐ」, which matches the cc-08 draft title.

measure.mjs now reports 「prose 2167 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 17.8 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 18)」. Prose went up from 1975 because the s4-table text is now counted as prose, and it is still inside the budget. para-sentences reports 「0 paragraph(s) over 3 sentences」, and lint --strict gives 0 errors and 0 warnings. Each s4-table item is 2 short sentences or fewer and adds no new term. The unexplained `>-` notation in ex-description (「長い説明文は、`>-` のあとで改行し、字下げして続けます。」) has not changed and still adds load to 7-2.

s2-skill still models 「何をするか」 and 「いつ使うか」 in its description, and its highlight [2–7] now covers exactly the name and the 4 description lines. ex-slash now names the action (「`/commit-message` と入力します。」), and ex-description says where the file goes (「できたフォルダに、エディターで `SKILL.md` を作ります。」). The subagent half of the practice is still not demonstrated before practice.

q3 d is one line, 「手順：`npm test` を実行する／失敗を一覧にする／原因を調べる」, and keeps its feedback. q2 can still be answered by recalling the key that s2-invoke names just before it. The new s4-table list is directly before q6, and its wording overlaps q6's options as the table did: 「何度も貼っているなら、**スキル**にします」 vs b 「毎週チャットに貼っている」, and 「Claudeが2回まちがえたら」 vs a 「Claudeが2回まちがえた」. This is no worse than before, but q6 (bloom evaluate) still leans on matching words.

The rewritten q3 d still targets the misconception that the steps belong in the description, and its feedback still fits (「手順は本文に書く内容です。説明文には、何をするスキルで、いつ使うのかを書きます。」). The other distractors and their feedback did not change.

s4-table is now a bullet list. Every item follows the same pattern of trigger, then tool in bold, then how it loads: 「同じ依頼文や手順書を何度も貼っているなら、**スキル**にします。説明文は毎回、本文は使うときに読み込まern」. Because each item starts with the trigger, the list signals the section title 「足すのは「きっかけ」が来てから」, and it fits mobile with no column squeeze. This also removes the old caption problem (「きっかけが来たら足す」 read against the row order). The bold tool name sits in the middle of each item, so scanning by tool is a little slower than in the table. s1-diagram (5 nodes) and s3-diagram are unchanged, and the 「本文は読み込まない」 branch is still not drawn.

pr-model is only re-wrapped: same content, and its highlight [3–6] still marks the description and 「disable-model-invocation: true」, which pr-model-lead explains. The task, the expect on every step, pr-prompt and pr-checklist did not change. pr-write still has a single hint (「7-2の `commit-message` を手本に」) before the full model answer.

summary-points comes after the exam. summary-next keeps the lesson-specific reflection (「スキルにしたい手順と、サブエージェントに任せたい調べものを1つずつ」) and names the next lesson by its exact title, 「第8回｜フックで守らせ、MCPでつなぐ」. It is followed by 6 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.

s4-table still cites cc-features-overview, and each claim matches the audit's quotes from that page. 「Claudeが2回まちがえたら、**CLAUDE.md**に書きます」 matches "Claude gets a convention or command wrong twice | Add it to CLAUDE.md". 「説明文は毎回、本文は使うときに読み込まれます」 matches "Descriptions at start, full content when used". 「見返さない調べものの出力が会話にあふれるなら、**サブエージェント**に任せます」 matches "A side task floods your conversation with output you won't reference again | Route it through a subagent". The old caption overclaimed that the content came from one 「公式の表」, and that caption is now gone. 「（第8回で扱います）」 is clearly the lesson's own pointer. The `>-` factual doubt from the last round has not changed.

The 4 new s4-table items use です・ます and stay warm and directive (「〜なら、**スキル**にします。」), and lint finds no banned phrases or long sentences. The tool names match the glossary (スキル, サブエージェント, フック, CLAUDE.md). Carried issue: the s1-diagram nodes say 「読む」 while its caption and alt say 「読み込まれる」. The ja-editor owns the wording.

The jp locale is complete. s4-table is now a semantic bullet list of 4 self-contained sentences, so a screen reader no longer has to read cell by cell. The s3-diagram alt matches what the diagram shows, and the s2-legacy link text is descriptive.

niceToHave: Verification: the previous review had no mustFix items, and none are open from earlier rounds, so `resolved` is empty. The one changed block, s4-table (table to bullet list), was reviewed in full. It adds no teaching error, factual error or regression, and it settles last round's s4-table niceToHave (the フック row against the header, and the caption against the row order).

s4-check q6 (unchanged, next to the changed s4-table): the options reuse the list's wording (「2回まちがえた」, 「貼っている」, 「会話にあふれた」), so learners can match words instead of judging. Change b to 「リリース前の確認手順（12ステップ）を、毎週チャットで一から説明し直している」 and c to 「ログの調査で、もう読まない出力が会話の大半を占めた」.
s4-table (changed): the block id still says `table`, but the block is now a list. The id is used to track reviews, so keep it unless the author renames it everywhere at once.
s2-steps ex-description (carried over): the `>-` sentence tells learners how to write it but not what it does. Replace with 「長い説明文は、`>-` のあとで改行し、同じ幅で字下げして続けます。数行が1つの説明文になります。1行で書いてもかまいません。」

factual doubt (carried over): the saved official skills.md and sub-agents.md pages show only single-line `description:` values, never a folded `>-` scalar. Before publishing, confirm in the repro folder that the folded descriptions in s2-skill and s3-file load correctly.

s2-skill / pr-model filenames (carried over): `commit-message/SKILL.md` drops `.claude/skills/`. If the width allows, use the full path. Otherwise add 「（`.claude/skills/` の中）」 to the s2-lead sentence.

s1-diagram (carried over): the 「本文は読み込まない」 branch is still not drawn, and q1 tests that contrast. Add `D -.->|それ以外| F[本文は
読まない]` if the width allows.
q3 d (carried over): the 「手順：」 prefix hints at the feedback. Consider 「`npm test` を実行し、失敗を一覧にして、原因を調べる。」
q2 (carried over): the answer is the key that s2-invoke names just before it. Consider asking which skill best fits `disable-model-invocation: true`.
hook-predict (carried over): add a prediction for the second problem in hook-b1, e.g. 「Claudeにサブエージェントで40個のファイルを読んでもらうと、メインの会話には何が残ると思いますか？」
pr-write (carried over): add a middle hint rung: 「説明文は「〜する。〜のときに使う。」の2文で、本文は①②③の番号つきの手順で書きます。」
summary: Verification round (mode verify): review-scope.mjs exited 0, with 1 of 72 parts changed (2%), so a full review was not required. No must-fix items were open. The only change turns s4-table from a 2-column table into a parallel bullet list (trigger, then tool, then how it loads). Its claims match cc-features-overview, it fits mobile better, and it settles last round's s4-table niceToHave. Validate and lint --strict are clean, and measure.mjs reports 「prose 2167 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 17.8 min」. Every criterion is 3 or higher, and the mean is 3.54.
